surface_strategy.description: Flat solid backgrounds with a 1px crisp border (border-[#E3E0D8]) to ground it. No glassmorphism (feels cold for health). Use sharp inner contrasts and subtle ambient shadows only on hover.

components_instructions.navigation_header: Solid background header with a 1px bottom border. Must include Logo, Account Dropdown, Settings Dialog trigger, and New Session CTA.
components_instructions.wizard_stepper: Vertical 'Editorial Ribbon' stepper on the left for desktop, horizontal scrollable for mobile. Active step uses primary color (#2C4A3B) with a subtle left border highlight. Inactive steps are muted (#5C6B64).
components_instructions.forms_inputs: Use Shadcn UI forms heavily customized to remove the 'Vercel' look. Inputs should have a soft background (#F8F7F3), 1px border, and focus states that ring with #2C4A3B.
components_instructions.cards_widgets: Flat, rectangular, cardless-feel where possible. For distinct groups (like Patient Vitals), use a 1px border and a very subtle shadow (shadow-sm).
components_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#2C4A3B] text-white hover:bg-[#1A2E26]. Accent buttons (like Generate SOAP): bg-[#C56F5D] text-white hover:bg-[#A65B4C]. Secondary: border-[#E3E0D8] text-[#1A2E26] hover:bg-[#F8F7F3].
components_instructions.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for switching between 'AI Mode' and 'Manual Mode' in Physical Exam.
components_instructions.modals_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for the Settings menu (Autotext dictionary, Greeting template, WhatsApp number, Gemini API Key). Dialogs must have solid #FFFFFF backgrounds, no heavy glass blur.

motion_interaction.hover_states: Buttons and links must have explicit hover text colors and background shifts. Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with a shadow-md on hover.
motion_interaction.transitions: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out for opacities and transforms. Never transition 'all'.

images.description: Minimalist photo of a stethoscope resting near a plant. Evokes calm, earthy, organic archetype. Perfect for splitting the login screen (50% image, 50% solid form).

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react (already installed). Keep stroke width at 1.5 for a sophisticated, light feel.

accessibility_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Text over primary buttons must be pure white. Text over backgrounds must be dark charcoal (#1A2E26).
accessibility_testing.data_testid: All interactive elements (inputs, buttons, wizard steps, tabs) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='wizard-step-1', data-testid='generate-soap-btn').

specific_flows.step_1_anamnesis: Large textarea. Must have a 'Process with AI' button that visually indicates the transition from raw notes to structured text.
specific_flows.step_2_physical: Toggle between AI input (textarea) and Manual input (grid of number inputs for HR, BP, RR, Temp, etc.).
specific_flows.step_3_assessment: Drag-and-drop zone with dashed border. Image preview. 'Analyze Image' button.
specific_flows.step_4_planning: Input field supporting autocomplete/dropdown for autotext injection.
specific_flows.step_5_final: A read-only 'document' view imitating a medical chart. Includes a prominent 'Send via WhatsApp' button (accent color).
